answer: Register each key with a proposed 2 POA bond; the contract counts four consecutive answered epochs before granting full reward eligibility. At every epoch close, a missing answer resets the streak and forfeits the bond, so a swarm must keep each key active. For 1,000 fake identities, 1,000 × 2 = 2,000 POA is at risk; one honest agent puts up 2 POA once. A polished account of spiral currents, reef life, or pigment chemistry cannot shorten the wait. This slows opportunistic swarms but not patient, wealthy attackers.
